owner_preference: animated and illustrated forms over photorealistic footage unless the material is itself footage-shaped

presets.description: Documentary / calm — photorealistic documentary footage; unhurried pacing; natural light; muted, earthy palette; steady tripod shots and slow pushes; observational distance; the tone of a serious long-form news feature.

News explainer / urgent — photorealistic news-package look; brisk pacing; high-contrast daylight and cool interior light; handheld energy, quick pans and push-ins; close on faces and hands; the tempo of a broadcast news segment.

Animated / friendly — clean 2D-style illustration in motion; warm, saturated palette; soft shapes, simple characters; smooth camera drifts; approachable explainer tone suitable for younger or general audiences.

Political poster art animation — 2D illustrated animation in the manner of revolutionary poster art and social-realist illustration; bold confident line work, flat color fills, hard-edged cell shading, 4-5 colors per scene; people are stylized illustrated figures with simplified expressive features and strong contours — never photorealistic humans; strong silhouettes, dignified proportions; solid

Editorial illustration in motion — the look of a hand-drawn newspaper or magazine illustration brought to life; ink outlines with watercolor or gouache washes, visible paper texture, restrained muted palette; people rendered as drawn characters with sketch-like faces — never photorealistic humans; gentle parallax and slow camera drifts; serious, literary tone.

News motion-graphics — clean vector shapes, iconographic figures and pictograms instead of realistic people, animated charts, maps and diagrams; bold flat palette on dark or light studio backgrounds; no on-screen text from the video model (words belong to narration and subtitles); the look of a broadcast explainer graphics package; no photorealistic humans anywhere.

Paper cutout collage animation — layered torn-edge paper and archival print textures, visible drop shadows between layers, stop-motion cadence; palette of cream paper, aged yellow, institutional blue, bureaucratic gray, ink black, with red-stamp-ink accents; people are cut-paper figures whose features are naturally abstracted by the medium — never photorealistic humans; any portrait-like element i

Black-and-white ink animation — stark monochrome in the woodcut and brush-ink graphic-novel tradition; heavy black shapes, high contrast, white negative space, visible stroke texture; people are maximally simplified universal figures — no skin tones, never photorealistic humans; static or minimal camera, the ink itself carries the motion.

Shadow theater — silhouette animation in the shadow-play and paper shadow-puppet tradition; pure black cut-out silhouettes with articulated joints and fine filigree edges against luminous atmospheric backdrops — dawn gradients, hazy lantern light, drifting mist; depth built from layered planes of shadow; people are black silhouettes by construction — the medium holds no facial features, never phot

Miniature isometric world — a clean stylized 3D diorama seen from a fixed three-quarter isometric angle, like a handcrafted architectural model; low-poly buildings, vehicles and landscapes with soft matte materials, gentle global illumination, shallow model-photography depth of field; people are tiny simplified faceless figurines — featureless heads, never photorealistic humans; the camera glides

Clay stop-motion — handcrafted plasticine animation; soft rounded clay forms with visible fingerprints and tool marks, matte modeling-clay colors, miniature-set depth with real shadows, stop-motion cadence with slight frame-to-frame jitter; people are simple clay figures with rudimentary features — dot eyes at most, never photorealistic humans; short deliberate movements; a warm handmade tone that

Blueprint schematic — technical-drawing animation on a deep blueprint-blue field; fine white and pale-cyan line work that draws itself: elevations, sections, isometric projections, exploded views, dashed guide lines; people are drafted outline figures — the scale figures of an architectural drawing, never photorealistic humans; precise ruled motion, slow zooms and pans across the drawing; the sobe

Embroidered textile — the film as stitched cloth; scenes rendered in visible embroidery thread on woven fabric, satin-stitch fills and running-stitch outlines, felt and appliqué patches, frayed thread ends; folk-art palette of natural dyes on unbleached linen; people are stitched folk figures whose faces are a few loose stitches — abstracted by the thread itself, never photorealistic humans; stop-

Sand animation — backlit sand on a light table; every scene is golden sand spread on glowing glass, drawn and erased by unseen hands, shapes continuously morphing into one another instead of cutting; deep amber-and-black monochrome, luminous negative space, visible grain; people are sand silhouettes with no facial detail — the medium cannot hold a face, never photorealistic humans; slow continuous

Neon glow-line — luminous line art on a near-black field; scenes traced in thin glowing strokes of two or three neon hues with soft bloom, like light painting or a long-exposure diagram; surfaces stay dark, only edges and paths glow; people are glowing outline figures with empty interiors — never photorealistic humans; lines draw themselves and pulse gently; a cool investigative tone for technolog
